metadata.title: chore: add lint, formatter and test checks to react client for CI workflow
metadata.author: marekdano

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue

Closes #4227

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
Added ESLint, Prettier, React Testing Library with Vitest to the client, integrated into GitHub Actions, created comprehensive integration tests, and documented everything in a README. Fix formatting.

**NOTE**: Please feel free to suggest more or better settings for the prettierrc.

## Summary of Changes

### 1. Code Quality Tools
- **Prettier** ([`client/.prettierrc`](client/.prettierrc)) - Code formatting with trailing commas everywhere
- **ESLint** ([`client/eslint.config.js`](client/eslint.config.js)) - Linting with Prettier integration
- **Scripts**: `lint`, `lint:fix`, `format`, `format:check`

### 2. Testing Infrastructure
- **Vitest** ([`client/vitest.config.ts`](client/vitest.config.ts)) - Fast test runner with jsdom
- **React Testing Library** - Component testing utilities
- **MSW** ([`client/src/test/mocks/`](client/src/test/mocks/)) - API mocking
- **Scripts**: `test`, `test:run`, `test:ui`, `test:coverage`

### 3. Test Setup Files
- [`client/src/test/setup.ts`](client/src/test/setup.ts) - MSW server lifecycle + window.matchMedia mock
- [`client/src/test/setup.d.ts`](client/src/test/setup.d.ts) - TypeScript declarations
- [`client/src/test/test-utils.tsx`](client/src/test/test-utils.tsx) - Custom render with I18nProvider
- [`client/src/test/mocks/handlers.ts`](client/src/test/mocks/handlers.ts) - Login and auth API handlers
- [`client/src/vitest.d.ts`](client/src/vitest.d.ts) - Global type declarations

### 4. TypeScript Configuration
- [`client/tsconfig.app.json`](client/tsconfig.app.json) - Added vitest/globals and jest-dom types
- Fixed all `toBeInTheDocument()` type errors

### 5. Integration Tests
[`client/src/App.test.tsx`](client/src/App.test.tsx) - Two tests:
- ✅ Renders login page when not authenticated
- ✅ Logs in, navigates to Gateways via sidebar, verifies title displays

### 6. GitHub Actions
[`.github/workflows/client-lint-test.yml`](.github/workflows/client-lint-test.yml) - Automated CI:
- Runs on push/PR to `main` and `epic/ui-rewrite`
- Executes: Prettier check → ESLint → Vitest tests

### 7. Documentation
[`client/README.md`](client/README.md) - Comprehensive documentation covering:
- Tech stack and getting started
- Code quality tools (ESLint, Prettier)
- Testing framework and best practices
- Writing tests with examples
- Mocking API endpoints
- CI/CD workflow
- Project structure
- Available scripts
- Troubleshooting guide
